title.zh: 将北甘马粦省圣维森特市镇圣何塞村San Jose小学的名称变更为Lucio Opedo小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of San Jose Elementary School in the Barrio of San Jose, Municipality of San Vicente, Province of Camarines Norte, to Lucio Opedo Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of San Jose Elementary School in the Barrio of San Jose, Municipality of San Vicente, Province of Camarines Norte, to Lucio Opedo Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường Tiểu học San Jose tại Barrio San Jose, Đô thị San Vicente, Tỉnh Camarines Norte thành Trường Tiểu học Lucio Opedo
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา San Jose ในบารังไกย์ San Jose เทศบาล San Vicente จังหวัด Camarines Norte เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Lucio Opedo
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Dasar San Jose di Barrio San Jose, Kotamadya San Vicente, Provinsi Camarines Norte menjadi Sekolah Dasar Lucio Opedo
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Sekolah Rendah San Jose di Barrio San Jose, Perbandaran San Vicente, Wilayah Camarines Norte kepada Sekolah Rendah Lucio Opedo

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1965/ra_4238_1965.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the San Jose Elementary School in the barrio of San Jose, Municipality of San Vicente, Province of Camarines Norte, is hereby changed to Lucio Opedo Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 19, 1965.
